title: Agents can now create Cloudflare accounts, buy domains, and deploy
summary: Cloudflare announces new agent capabilities allowing AI agents to programmatically create accounts, purchase domains, and deploy web projects through their platform, enabling fully autonomous web deployment workflows.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents to autonomously handle web deployment tasks including account creation, domain registration, and service deployment without human intervention.
why_valuable: This represents a major step toward autonomous agent-driven DevOps, allowing developers to build workflows where AI agents can independently provision and manage cloud infrastructure.
